comments.body:
Well, I disagree strongly... However, have u read their demands? There is NOTHING about supporting any violence. What they want is transparency in ETH research and funding sources (not regarding the confidential content tho, but simply for the students to see WHO ETH works for)... they also want to organise support for Muslim, Palestine and JEWISH students affected by the conflict ( the same way it was done for the Ukrainian students)... and they want to admit the genocide of Palestinians... 

I think it's important for STUDENTS to at least DISCUSS the topic... I would not agree that this action is even half-heartedly aggressive... anyway...
comments.author: DyingFish3000
